# chassis_controls Testing

This section of the package helps with system identification and controller tuning.

## Usage

- Perform tests by editing hardware/drive_hardware.cpp and drive the rover back and forth in increments of 5% pwm starting at 0%.

- Move all log files generated by the ros2-control-node during those tests into a folder in this directory

- Rename the log files according to the naming convention: XXX_percent_pwm.log, where XXX is the percentage, ie: 025.

- Open data_logging.ipynb and run all cells, read comments and check results as you go.

- Check that wheel_data.csv has been properly formed, and open MATLAB

- Run pid_tuning.m and adjust the transient response for all 4 controllers until satisfied

- Click Show Parameters, and save Kp, Ki and Kd for each controller. Upload the gains to the init method of hardware/drive_hardware.cpp

- Congrats on your new, tuned drive system!
